title: Lightstreamer Connection Error Handling
description:
Add robust error handling for Lightstreamer connection failures including:

- Connection timeout handling
- Automatic reconnection logic with exponential backoff
- Connection state monitoring and health checks
- Graceful degradation when service is unavailable
- Logging and monitoring for connection events
- Circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures

This ensures the telemetry ingestion service can handle network issues and service interruptions gracefully while maintaining system reliability.
